BytesStatus.description: What a checker finds of a planned result's bytes.
BytesStatus.title: BytesStatus

CheckedEvidence.description: An item of evidence that cites an output, and the status it gets.

analysis.description: The analysis whose file holds the item.

pointer.description: A JSON Pointer to the item in that analysis's `fields`, such as `/findings/insight1/evidence/0`.

record_status.description: The worst record status of the results the item cites; `missing` where it cites none.

CheckedEvidence.title: CheckedEvidence

CheckedPlace.description: A planned result's statuses at one of its places.

address.description: The name, then, for a result built in a universe, `#` and that universe's own id, such as `stage.output3#u1`. With the result's `owner`, it names the result.

bytes.description: The path of the default place of the result's bytes.

bytes_status.description: The status of the bytes at the default place. Left out for a result from a commit that no recipe reads.

committed.description: Whether git holds the record at the place as it is.

name.description: The result's name: its output's id after the ids of the driven declarations that lead to it from the analysis it belongs to, such as `stage.output3`.

provenance.description: The record at the place, where it is the result's: its status is `unchanged` or `stale`. It may follow a later minor version of the specification, so it may hold fields this schema doesn't define.

reasons.description: The check rules broken at the place.

record.description: The path of the result's record at the place.

record_status.description: The status of the record at the place.

CheckedPlace.title: CheckedPlace

CheckedResult.description: A planned result, with its statuses at each of its places.

output.description: The output the result is of, never a switch.

owner.description: The analysis the result belongs to: the one whose universe builds it or, for an output built once, the one whose output it is.

places.description: The result's places, as the resolved analysis gives them, each with its statuses.

universe.description: The id of the universe the result is built in, one of its owner's. Left out for an output built once.

CheckedResult.title: CheckedResult

Diagnostic.description: A rule broken: its code, how it counts, and where.

breaks.description: In a check report, for a record that doesn't parse or meet its schema, the code of the rule the record breaks.

code.description: The rule's code, one of the specification's codes table or one of the tool's own, such as `UNRESOLVED_ADDRESS`.

message.description: What is wrong and what to do about it, in a sentence.

related.description: The other places the diagnostic is about.

Diagnostic.title: Diagnostic

ElementRef.description: What names an element of an analysis: the analysis and the element's id there. The kind of element follows from the field that holds the reference.

analysis.description: The analysis the element is in.

id.description: The element's id in that analysis.

ElementRef.title: ElementRef

Environment.description: The environment a recipe ran in, named by an IRI.

iri.description: An IRI naming exactly that environment, enough for its runner, at the version the record gives, to recreate it, such as a `urn:` IRI (`urn:example:env:sha256:…`) or one in a scheme of the runner's own.

Environment.title: Environment

Generation.description: A run of an output's recipe: the commit it ran from, what it read, the environment it ran in and the runner that ran it.

commit.description: The full id of the git commit the recipe ran from: a commit of the repository the record is committed in, the submodule's own commit for a result that belongs to an analysis in a submodule (the driver's commit for what a driver's universes build). It pins every file of the code and every `astra.yaml` in that repository: an analysis in a submodule of it through the commit the submodule is pinned at, and an analysis from a commit through its declaration's `commit`.

environment.description: The environment the recipe ran in.

finished.description: When the recipe finished, in UTC to the millisecond, such as `2026-10-26T14:00:02.000Z`.

inputs.description: What the recipe read: one item for each entry the output's `inputs` lists in the `astra.yaml` files at the record's `commit`, and no other item, matched by `entry`; the order of the items carries no meaning. A later change to the list makes the result `stale`, not `missing`.

runner.description: The runner that ran the recipe.

started.description: When the recipe started, in UTC to the millisecond, such as `2026-10-26T14:00:00.000Z`.

Generation.title: Generation

Identity.description: What names an analysis: its folder and the commit it is read at. One folder at one commit is one analysis, however it is declared.

commit.description: The full id of the commit the analysis is read at. Left out for the working tree.

folder.description: The analysis's folder, as a path. The top of the tree is the empty string.

Identity.title: Identity

Location.description: Where a diagnostic or a note is: a file, and a place in it.

column.description: The column of the place in its line, counted from 1.

commit.description: The full id of the commit the file is read at. Left out for the working tree.

file.description: The file's path from the top of the repository that holds it.

key.description: The map key or field named at the place.

line.description: The line of the place in the file, counted from 1.

pointer.description: A JSON Pointer to the place in the file. The whole file is the empty string.

url.description: The remote the file is read from, if any.

Location.title: Location

ProvenanceRecord.description: The provenance of one result, which the runner that made it writes as JSON: what the result is and the run of the recipe that made it. Read as RDF, its top-level node stands for the result.

address.description: The result's address, as the analysis it belongs to names it: the output's id after the ids of the driven declarations that lead to it, then, for a result built in a universe, `#` and that universe's own id, never an import's, such as `subanalysis.output1#u1`.

content_hash.description: The SHA-256 digest of the result's file, never of something standing in for it.

generated_by.description: The run of the recipe that made the result.

size.description: The size of the result's file in bytes, never of something standing in for it.

spec_version.description: The version of the ASTRA specification the record follows, such as `0.1.0`.

ProvenanceRecord.title: ProvenanceRecord

RecordStatus.description: What a checker finds of a planned result's record.
RecordStatus.title: RecordStatus

RecordedInput.description: One of the output's inputs, as the recipe read it: the entry, and the content hash and size of what the recipe read through it.

content_hash.description: The SHA-256 digest of the content the recipe read through the entry, another output's result or the file an input names, never of something standing in for it.

entry.description: The entry exactly as the output's `inputs` lists it in the `astra.yaml` files at the record's `commit`, such as `input1`.

size.description: The size in bytes of the content the recipe read through the entry, never of something standing in for it.

RecordedInput.title: RecordedInput

Runner.description: The software that ran the recipe and wrote the record.
Runner.title: Runner

description: What checking an analysis found: whether each planned result's record is still true of the analysis, and whether its bytes are there.

at.description: What the analysis, its records and its bytes are read at: `worktree`, or the full id of a commit.

errors.description: The `MUST`s the analysis breaks, as a validator finds them.

evidence.description: The evidence checked, in the resolved analysis's order. An item is matched to the resolved analysis's by its `analysis` and `pointer`.

results.description: The planned results checked, in the order of the resolved analysis read at the same `at`. A result is matched to the resolved analysis's by its `owner` and its first place's `address`.

root.description: The driving analysis's `astra.yaml`, as a path from the top of the repository that holds it.

shape.description: The name and version of the document's shape.

title: documents
